title: Silas's Smuggling Ledger
author: Silas the Scribe
content: The shipment of star-metal arrived through the Old Mill watergate at midnight. Silas moved the reinforced coffer into the flooded crypt vault beneath St. Jude's. Inform the Obsidian Syndicate that payment is due before the next tide.
cipherHint: Elder Futhark rune substitution commonly favored by dockside shadow brokers.
sessionNotes: Discovered hidden inside an oily leather pouch under Silas's writing desk.

title: Lady Cynthia's Sealed Missive
author: Lady Cynthia Ravenscroft
content:
Captain Drake,

My house cannot abide another day of delay at the docks. Whatever your men recovered from the sunken barge must remain sealed in iron and kept far from the Highspire Guard.

If the Grand Magistrate inspects the cargo manifests, neither your lineage nor my coin will shield us from the gallows.

Deliver the key to Brog by tomorrow evening, and burn this missive upon reading.

With utmost discretion,
Cynthia Ravenscroft
sessionNotes: Found in Drake's locked coat pocket after the tavern altercation.

title: Corvin's Scorched Journal Page
author: Corvin the Delver
content:
The floodwaters are rising faster than we calculated. The gears at the third floodgate didn't jam by accident—the iron release bar was driven through with dwarven chisel spikes from the inside.

We heard rhythmic tapping behind the ossuary masonry. It matches no masonry code. It responds only when our torches burn low.

Gods preserve us... whatever slept beneath the monastery was awake before the first wall cracked.
sessionNotes: Found clutched in the skeletal hand of an explorer pinned under fallen debris.

title: Watch Bounty: Brog the Iron-Breaker
author: High Magistrate Aldous Vane
content:
COMMAND OF THE HIGH COURT OF OAKHAVEN

Let it be known across all wards that the fugitive known as 'Brog the Iron-Breaker' is declared an enemy of the Crown.

CHARGES: Aggravated arson at the Cinder-Forge, inciting sedition among the foundry smiths, and grand theft of high-yield alchemical blackpowder.

WARNING: The suspect is of towering build, wields an oversized iron forge-hammer, and resists arrest with lethal violence. Bring him in chains, or bring proof of his demise to the Highspire Barracks.
bountyCrimes: Arson, Sedition, Sledgehammer Battery, Powder Theft
sessionNotes: Posted on the corkboard outside the Watch Barracks and inside the Black Boar Tavern.

title: Rite of the Abyssal Threshold
author: Circle of the Pale Moon
content:
When the crescent moon dips beneath the drowned bells of the monastery, smear the threshold with tallow rendered from a deep-trench eel.

Intone the nine syllables of Morvath thrice without taking breath. The drowned gate shall swing inward for thirteen heartbeats.

HEED THIS WARNING: Never cross the salt line after the bell tolls midnight, lest the mirror-shadow claim your reflection as its own.
sessionNotes: Inscribed upon glowing vellum salvaged from an eldritch chest in the flooded ruins.
